name: Is kitchen painting and trim work worth it, or should I remodel instead?

mainEntity.name: Is kitchen painting and trim work worth it, or should I remodel instead?

acceptedAnswer.text: For many homeowners, painting cabinets and trim is a strong value play because it can dramatically change the look of the kitchen without a full remodel. It makes the most sense when the layout still works, the wood is in decent condition, and you want a cleaner, updated look fast.
acceptedAnswer.description: It’s usually worth it when you want a major visual upgrade without full replacement. If the cabinets are sound, paint can deliver a strong return for less disruption.
